commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
90+4' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+3' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Freiburg fail to score from a corner as Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln) leaps to collect the ball.
88' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
88' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
87' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a change. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) replaces Rav van den Berg.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln) is replacing Linton Maina.

83' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
81' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) brings his opponent down. Bastian Dankert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln get a free kick.
80' A snap shot by Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Marvin Schwabe flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
77' Here comes a substitution. Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Kristoffer Lund.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tom Krauss walks off the pitch to be replaced by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln).
76' Here is a change. Derry Scherhant is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Igor Matanovic will be replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
76' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
74' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
74' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) is cautioned by the referee.
73' FC Koln earn a corner.
71' Bastian Dankert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln).
69' The referee gives a yellow card to Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
67' Here comes a substitution. Jan Thielmann is given a rest as he is replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
67' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Marvin Schwabe pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
66' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
65' We are about to witness a penalty kick. The referee points directly to the penalty spot.

65' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. The referee blows his whistle and awards Freiburg a penalty after chaos inside the box.
64' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) hits the free kick from the edge of the box, but can't find the target. His shot flies miles wide of the right post.
63' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Patrick Osterhage and he is replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
63' Substitution. Max Rosenfelder will be replaced by Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg).
62' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) for his blatant foul.
60' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
59' 52:48 – the latest ball possession ratio.
55' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is being substituted because of an injury. Julian Schuster sends Christian Gunter on the pitch.
53' The game is interrupted now, Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
51' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu easily deals with the threat.
49' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

49' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
47' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 1 Goal! Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
43' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) sends the corner into the box, but Marvin Schwabe intercepts it and averts the threat.
43' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Good work from Freiburg as they win a corner.
39' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

37' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
36' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
29' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
26' A cross from Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
23' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
22' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
20' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Igor Matanovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
17' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but it's cleared.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! Yuito Suzuki found Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Marvin Schwabe off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
10' 0 - 1 This is definitely not what Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
6' It looked like the long-range shot by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
4' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
2' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
